title: Twindragon Fractal
description: An infinitely detailed fractal built from one simple rule, repeated forever.
long_description:
The twindragon fractal is generated by repeating one simple equation over and over. Zoom in anywhere and you'll find a self-similar structure again and again, and the boundary between light and dark never smooths out no matter how far you zoom.

From your phone, shift the zoom depth and colors, or jump straight to a few favorite deep-zoom spots.
